title: Pleats and Pants
concept: Where structured tailoring meets fluid movement.
description: A digital reconstruction of Neiman Marcus pleated trousers, exploring the interplay between tailored structure and soft draping. High-waisted proportions, sculptural front pleats, and a tapered silhouette are recreated in CLO 3D, with a pastel blue silk-like crepe material that emphasizes subtle texture, luminosity, and natural fabric movement.

first.alt: close up front render pleated pants
first.caption: Construction detail

construction.fit: High-waisted tailored fit with a defined waistband, generous volume through the hips, and a softly tapered leg.
construction.pockets: Slanted side pockets integrated into the upper hip area, following the natural flow of the pleats.
construction.seams: Clean, discreet seam construction with minimal visible topstitching. Subtle seam definition preserves the smooth, refined appearance of the garment.
construction.fabric: Pastel blue silk-like chambray crepe with a fine woven texture, soft luminosity, and fluid drape. The simulated fabric balances gentle structure at the waist with natural folds and movement along the legs.
construction.volume: Deep front pleats create controlled volume through the upper leg, transitioning into an elongated, tapered silhouette. A clean waistband reinforces the tailored construction.

reference.alt: Model wearing a Marcus Neiman pleated pants
reference.caption: Neiman Marcus pleated trousers — original design used as a visual reference for digital pattern reconstruction, silhouette study, and fabric interpretation.
